naga_kabsa.name: Coiled Naga Kabsa
naga_kabsa.description: Naga scale shaved into spiced rice and slow-steamed with ember spice in the Arabian fashion. The grains glisten as if still breathing.
naga_kabsa.sprite_desc: A copper platter heaped with saffron rice and dark scale shavings, a small clay cup of red oil at the rim

thoth_ink_risotto.name: Thoth's Scribal Ink Risotto
thoth_ink_risotto.description: Squid-black risotto stirred with luminous spore until each grain absorbs the ink and brightens. Scholars say the dish remembers what you have read.
thoth_ink_risotto.sprite_desc: A white porcelain bowl of jet-black risotto flecked with pale glowing dots, served with a single silver spoon

cyclops_pyrgos_pie.name: Cyclopean Pyrgos Pie
cyclops_pyrgos_pie.description: A rustic Greek hill-shepherd's pie with the giant's eye whole at the center, surrounded by cave mushrooms. They say the eye keeps watching from the pan.
cyclops_pyrgos_pie.sprite_desc: A round earthenware pie with a single yellow eyeball staring from the top, dark mushroom slices arranged in a ring around it

sphinx_kaiseki.name: Sphinx-Mane Kaiseki Course
sphinx_kaiseki.description: Twin tufts of sphinx mane plated with a single thyme sprig in the spare Japanese style. Eaters report dreaming in riddles for three nights after.
sphinx_kaiseki.sprite_desc: A long black lacquer tray with two small golden tufts of mane on white rice paper and one green thyme sprig

displacer_falafel.name: Displacer's Misdirection Falafel
displacer_falafel.description: Levantine falafel ground from displacer hide and pickled cave carrot. Reach for the bite, miss by an inch, taste it from the other side of the plate.
displacer_falafel.sprite_desc: A clay plate of golden-crisp falafel balls slightly out of focus, with bright orange pickled carrot ribbons between them

mound_mulch_dolma.name: Shambling-Mound Dolma
mound_mulch_dolma.description: Compost-loam from a shambling mound bound with rosemary and wrapped in grape leaves. Earthy, sour, and stubbornly nourishing.
mound_mulch_dolma.sprite_desc: Six dark-green dolma rolls arranged on a white plate, flecked with rosemary needles and dressed with olive oil

lindworm_paprikash.name: Lindworm Paprikash
lindworm_paprikash.description: Hungarian paprikash with lindworm skin diced into the cream. The skin still flinches in the pan; the pepper hides it.
lindworm_paprikash.sprite_desc: A cast-iron pan of deep red stew with white sour-cream swirls and chunks of dark lindworm skin, a wooden spoon resting in it

anubis_funerary_loaf.name: Anubis Funerary Loaf
anubis_funerary_loaf.description: Egyptian funeral bread baked with embalming resin and a single grain of void salt. The crust hardens like a death mask and your eyes adjust to the dark for hours.
anubis_funerary_loaf.sprite_desc: A small round dark-amber loaf scored with hieroglyph-like markings, a black salt crystal pressed into the top

ogre_steppe_borscht.name: Ogre-Bone Steppe Borscht
ogre_steppe_borscht.description: Russian steppe borscht thickened with rendered ogre fat and a long simmer of cave roots. The cook tradition says one spoonful, one winter survived.
ogre_steppe_borscht.sprite_desc: A wide wooden bowl of deep crimson borscht with a dollop of cream, chunks of pale celery and orange carrot, a black bread crust on the side

wyvern_pho.name: Wyvern Stinger Pho
wyvern_pho.description: Vietnamese pho broth clarified with a wyvern stinger and steeped with valerian. The numb-tingle on the tongue is the venom; the warmth in the chest is the cook.
wyvern_pho.sprite_desc: A wide white bowl of clear amber broth with thin rice noodles, herbs, and a single dark curved stinger laid across the top

owlbear_tagine.name: Owlbear Tagine of Three Roots
owlbear_tagine.description: Moroccan tagine slow-cooked in a sealed conical pot with owlbear plume, three roots, and a long argument between cinnamon and ember. Comes off the fire after a full sand-glass.
owlbear_tagine.sprite_desc: A tall conical clay tagine with the lid lifted just enough to show stewed roots, feathers, and a curl of dark steam

elder_blood_sangue_marenne.name: Sangue Maremma alla Vampira
elder_blood_sangue_marenne.description: Tuscan blood pudding from an elder nosferatu, set firm with void salt and finished with rosemary smoke. Eat it warm before the moon turns.
elder_blood_sangue_marenne.sprite_desc: A dark glistening blood-pudding cut into a wedge on a white plate, a sprig of rosemary across it and a dust of black salt

behir_biryani.name: Behir Lightning Biryani
behir_biryani.description: Hyderabadi-style layered biryani built around behir scale, the rice crackling faintly as the dish rests. Each bite carries a flicker of charge to the limbs.
behir_biryani.sprite_desc: A copper pot of layered saffron-and-white rice with dark scale chips between the layers, a faint blue spark in the steam

void_shard_kvass.name: Void-Shard Black Kvass
void_shard_kvass.description: Slavic rye kvass fermented with a chip of void shard suspended in the cask. Tastes of pumpernickel and outer dark in equal measure.
void_shard_kvass.sprite_desc: A clay tankard of nearly-black liquid with a faint star-point in the depths, a wooden lid resting beside it

titan_polenta_aurea.name: Titan's Polenta Aurea
titan_polenta_aurea.description: Roman gilded polenta enriched with rendered titan essence and a finishing sprig of thyme. Heavy on the spoon, heavier in the gut, heaviest in the arm.
titan_polenta_aurea.sprite_desc: A golden mound of polenta on a wide stone plate, drizzled with bright oil, a single thyme sprig laid across the top

erlking_oden.name: Erlking's Winter Oden
erlking_oden.description: Japanese oden simmered with a snapped twig of the Erlking's crown and valerian root, kept on low heat all night. The broth listens.
erlking_oden.sprite_desc: A square iron pot of pale dashi with a small twig and root floating among daikon and egg, a wooden ladle hanging on the rim

sea_dragon_ceviche.name: Sea Dragon Ceviche
sea_dragon_ceviche.description: Peruvian ceviche of sea-dragon scale-meat cured in lime, serpent pepper, and ice-cold brine. The first bite opens the eyes wider than they have ever opened.
sea_dragon_ceviche.sprite_desc: A shallow ceramic bowl of pale dragon-meat cubes in cloudy lime juice, bright red pepper rings around the rim

void_ichor_korma.name: Star-Spawn Void Korma
void_ichor_korma.description: Mughal-court korma with star-spawn ichor folded into the cream and mandrake ground fine for body. The dish is calm; the eater becomes calm; the spells slide off.
void_ichor_korma.sprite_desc: A small brass bowl of pale lavender-cream curry with dark flecks, a piece of warm flatbread on the side

camazotz_mole_negro.name: Camazotz Mole Negro
camazotz_mole_negro.description: Oaxacan mole negro built around bat-god wing membrane and a long cradle of fungus, chili, and chocolate. Black as a cave at midnight, twice as smooth.
camazotz_mole_negro.sprite_desc: A clay bowl of dense black mole sauce with a single bat-wing strip emerging from the surface, a tortilla folded at the rim

hydra_kabsa.name: Seven-Heads Kabsa
hydra_kabsa.description: Saudi kabsa with hydra bile thinned into the rice stock, served on a single platter for an army. Each spoonful tastes like the head that grew it.
hydra_kabsa.sprite_desc: A wide brass tray of spiced golden rice piled high, dark stew chunks at the peak, a small bowl of green sauce in the corner

demon_heart_kofta.name: Nalfeshnee Heart Kofta
demon_heart_kofta.description: Persian kofta meatballs minced from demon heart, rolled in rosemary, finished on a wood grill. The fat that drips off ignites on its own.
demon_heart_kofta.sprite_desc: Six dark-crusted meatballs on a long iron skewer, glossy with red oil, charred herbs scattered across them

behir_storm_feast.name: Behir Storm-King Feast
behir_storm_feast.description: A four-course Hindustani thali built entirely on storm-charged ingredients. The plate hums when the kitchen quiets.
behir_storm_feast.sprite_desc: A round silver thali plate with five small bowls of differently colored curries and rice in the center, faint blue arcs above the surface

erlking_lamia_dolma.name: Erlking-Lamia Dolma Platter
erlking_lamia_dolma.description: A five-element forest-court platter: bound twig, scale-leaf, root, mushroom, stalk. Eaten standing, the way the old courts did.
erlking_lamia_dolma.sprite_desc: A wide oak plank with five small piles of food arranged in a pentagram, each a different color, a single twig laid across the center

cacus_smoke_brisket.name: Cacus's Smoke-Cave Brisket
cacus_smoke_brisket.description: Beef brisket smoked twelve hours in the ember-gut of the cave giant, finished with wild thyme. The smoke is the cooking; the thyme is the apology.
cacus_smoke_brisket.sprite_desc: A long dark-bark crust of brisket sliced thin on a wooden board, smoke still curling from the cut face, thyme sprigs across the top

demi_lich_kalan.name: Demi-Lich Kalan
demi_lich_kalan.description: South Indian kalan, a yogurt-coconut stew, with demi-lich skull ground into the spice paste. The bone meal sharpens thought; the coconut keeps you civil.
demi_lich_kalan.sprite_desc: A small banana-leaf bowl of pale yellow curry with white coconut shreds, a single tiny bone fragment visible on top

frost_crawler_kakigori.name: Frost-Crawler Kakigori
frost_crawler_kakigori.description: Japanese shaved-ice kakigori spun from a frost gland and dusted with valerian sugar. The cold settles the mind faster than any tea.
frost_crawler_kakigori.sprite_desc: A pale glass dish piled with translucent shaved ice, a drizzle of dark syrup, and a single root chip on top

roc_talon_pelmeni.name: Roc Talon Pelmeni
roc_talon_pelmeni.description: Siberian pelmeni dumplings folded around roc-talon mince and pin-bone, boiled and served in their own broth. They say the eater hears wings for the rest of the night.
roc_talon_pelmeni.sprite_desc: A wide pewter bowl of small crescent dumplings floating in golden broth, a sour cream dollop in the center, carrot ribbons around the edge

storm_essence_ukha.name: Storm-Giant Ukha
storm_essence_ukha.description: Russian fisherman's ukha clarified with one drop of storm essence and seasoned only with void salt. Clear as rain, heavy as cloud.
storm_essence_ukha.sprite_desc: A shallow wooden bowl of utterly clear pale broth with three small dark grains floating in the center, a wooden spoon resting across

blue_dragon_birria.name: Blue Dragon Birria
blue_dragon_birria.description: Jaliscan birria stewed with blue dragon scale shaved fine. The dipping consomme crackles faintly between the lips.
blue_dragon_birria.sprite_desc: A clay bowl of deep brick-red stew with cobalt scale flakes floating on top, a folded tortilla beside it and a small dipping cup of broth

cerberus_bigos.name: Cerberus Hunter's Bigos
cerberus_bigos.description: Polish hunter's bigos slow-cooked three days with cerberus saliva turning the cabbage. The sauerkraut bites back; the wolf meat keeps it civil.
cerberus_bigos.sprite_desc: A heavy iron pot of dark-brown shredded cabbage stew with chunks of dark meat, a clay mug of beer beside it on a wooden table

rangda_jamu_tonic.name: Rangda Jamu Tonic
rangda_jamu_tonic.description: Balinese jamu boiled hard with a splinter of the demon queen's mask, mandrake root, and ginger. The first sip turns spells aside; the second sip turns prayers aside.
rangda_jamu_tonic.sprite_desc: A small dark glass jar of cloudy yellow liquid with a wooden stopper, a fragment of red lacquer mask resting beside it

sphinx_riddle_kaiseki.name: Sphinx Riddle Kaiseki
sphinx_riddle_kaiseki.description: A three-element kaiseki: stone, herb, light. Each course is a single bite. By the third bite you have answered the riddle without speaking.
sphinx_riddle_kaiseki.sprite_desc: Three small lacquered dishes in a row, each with one tiny perfect element: a polished stone, a green sprig, a glowing dot

marilith_six_arms.name: Marilith's Six-Arm Mezze
marilith_six_arms.description: Levantine mezze laid out in six small dishes, each built around a demon scale prepared a different way. Eat them in any order; the result is the same.
marilith_six_arms.sprite_desc: A round brass tray with six small bowls arranged like a clock, each containing differently colored scale preparations, a single flatbread in the center

lesser_draco_haggis.name: Draco-Bone Haggis
lesser_draco_haggis.description: Scottish haggis with undead dragon bone-marrow worked through the oats. Heavy, peaty, and unsettlingly persistent on the breath.
lesser_draco_haggis.sprite_desc: A round dark sphere of haggis split open on a wooden plate, the steaming oat-and-bone interior exposed, sprigs of thyme around it

chaos_essence_tagine_grand.name: Chaos-Glabrezu Grand Tagine
chaos_essence_tagine_grand.description: A five-ingredient royal tagine with chaos essence stirred in last so the dish never settles the same way twice. The cook prays before lifting the lid.
chaos_essence_tagine_grand.sprite_desc: A tall painted tagine with the conical lid askew, a thick dark-amber stew bubbling inside, five small piles of garnish on a board beside it

nightwing_cassoulet.name: Nightwing Cassoulet de Minuit
nightwing_cassoulet.description: Languedoc cassoulet finished with nightwing membrane laid across the crust like a dark sail. The crust crackles; the beans below have remembered the sky.
nightwing_cassoulet.sprite_desc: A wide brown earthenware dish with deep crust on top, a sheet of dark membrane stretched across, beans visible at the cracked edges

fafnir_eisbein.name: Fafnir Eisbein
fafnir_eisbein.description: Bavarian pork knuckle reimagined with Fafnir-scale brined in void salt and roasted to a glass-hard crackle. Sigurd ate worse and lived shorter.
fafnir_eisbein.sprite_desc: A large dark-roasted joint on a wooden board, crackling skin scored in a diamond pattern, a mound of sauerkraut beside it

lich_dragon_tezcat.name: Lich Dragon Tezcatlipoca
lich_dragon_tezcat.description: Mexica obsidian-grill plate of lich dragon scale charred and folded into ember spice. Smoking-mirror cuisine: every bite you almost see something behind you.
lich_dragon_tezcat.sprite_desc: A black volcanic-stone plate with a curl of dark charred scale on one side and a small pyramid of red spice on the other

nemean_giblet_tagine.name: Nemean Giblet Tagine
nemean_giblet_tagine.description: Moroccan tagine slow-simmered with invulnerable pelt scrap broken down into impossibly tender meat. The trick is sixteen hours and no peeking.
nemean_giblet_tagine.sprite_desc: A glazed conical tagine pot with the lid set beside it, golden carrot rings around the rim, a mass of fall-apart meat in the center

adult_dragon_heart_pho_bo.name: Adult Dragon-Heart Pho Bo
adult_dragon_heart_pho_bo.description: Vietnamese pho bo where the broth is the dragon's heart simmered alone for a day, finished with a single rosemary sprig. Drink the broth first; the noodles are afterthought.
adult_dragon_heart_pho_bo.sprite_desc: A deep ceramic bowl of clear ruby-red broth with thin rice noodles, a single rosemary sprig laid across the surface like a sword

rangda_terrine.name: Rangda Mask-Splinter Terrine
rangda_terrine.description: French country terrine pressed cold with rangda mask splinters layered between forcemeat. Slice thin; the splinters become tiny watchful eyes in the cut face.
rangda_terrine.sprite_desc: A rectangular terrine sliced into rounds on a wooden board, dark flecks visible in each pale slice, cornichons in a small jar beside

fafnir_dolma_grand.name: Fafnir's Grand Dolma
fafnir_dolma_grand.description: Anatolian dolma rolled with dragon scale rice inside vine leaves treated with rosemary smoke and ember spice. The eater stops noticing kitchen heat for the rest of the day.
fafnir_dolma_grand.sprite_desc: A round white plate of nine tightly rolled dark-green dolma, a small bowl of yogurt in the center dusted with red spice

nightwing_kabuki_skewer.name: Nightwing Kabuki Skewer
nightwing_kabuki_skewer.description: Yakitori-style charcoal skewer of nightwing membrane folded and pressed flat, painted with void-salt brine. Eat with the off hand; you may not be where you think.
nightwing_kabuki_skewer.sprite_desc: A single charcoal-grilled skewer of dark folded membrane glistening with salt, a few thyme leaves stuck to the surface

adult_dragon_curry_grand.name: Adult Dragon Curry Grand Cru
adult_dragon_curry_grand.description: Sri Lankan curry built on dragon heart, scale, and root, the spice mix toasted over an open flame for an hour before grinding. The pot stains the kitchen forever.
adult_dragon_curry_grand.sprite_desc: A heavy brass curry pot blackened on the outside, deep amber curry inside, a wooden ladle with a charred handle resting on the rim

lich_dragon_smorrebrod.name: Lich Dragon Smorrebrod Course
lich_dragon_smorrebrod.description: Danish open-faced rye topped with cured lich-dragon scale, void-salt pickle, and pale celery curl. The kind of lunch that ends a Scandinavian winter argument.
lich_dragon_smorrebrod.sprite_desc: Three squares of dense dark rye bread on a long board, each topped with thin slices of dark scale, white pickled celery, and a sprinkle of salt

rangda_grand_kemenyan.name: Rangda's Kemenyan Five-Spice Roast
rangda_grand_kemenyan.description: Balinese ceremonial roast scented with five aromatic woods and finished with a circle of mask splinters around the meat. Reserved for nights of new moon.
rangda_grand_kemenyan.sprite_desc: A large roasted joint on a banana leaf, a ring of red mask fragments laid around it, smoke from charcoal still curling above

nightwing_dragon_cassolette.name: Nightwing-Dragon Cassolette
nightwing_dragon_cassolette.description: A small French cassolette with three winged-beast components layered above a void-salt crust. The center sinks as it cools; the eater stays upright.
nightwing_dragon_cassolette.sprite_desc: A small white ramekin with golden-brown crust on top, a single dark sheet of membrane peeled back to show layered scales beneath

pit_fiend_bouillabaisse.name: Pit Fiend Bouillabaisse
pit_fiend_bouillabaisse.description: Marseille bouillabaisse with pit fiend scale instead of saffron and void salt instead of sea salt. The broth burns the throat the right way.
pit_fiend_bouillabaisse.sprite_desc: A wide enameled pot of dark crimson seafood stew, dark scale chips floating among shells, a slice of crusty bread on the side

jormungandr_lutefisk.name: Jormungandr Lutefisk
jormungandr_lutefisk.description: Norse lutefisk made from juvenile world-serpent flesh cured in lye-bark and rosemary smoke. Translucent, faintly electric, served with butter.
jormungandr_lutefisk.sprite_desc: A pale translucent fillet of fish on a white plate, a pat of butter melting beside it, a sprig of rosemary across the top

sets_jackal_tagine_grand.name: Set's Jackal Tagine of the Red Land
sets_jackal_tagine_grand.description: Upper Egyptian desert tagine simmered with the jackal-god's fang and a heap of ember spice. The lid is sealed with bread dough; opening it takes patience the cook learned in the temple.
sets_jackal_tagine_grand.sprite_desc: A clay tagine with dried bread sealing the rim, deep red stew visible through a small steam hole at the top of the cone

baba_yaga_blini.name: Baba Yaga's Mortar Blini
baba_yaga_blini.description: Russian blini fried in mortar dust like flour, stacked with valerian-cream between. The crone signs each plate; the signature is gone by the second bite.
baba_yaga_blini.sprite_desc: A tall stack of pale-grey blini pancakes on a black plate, white cream visible between every layer, a small jar of dark jam beside

pit_fiend_garum.name: Pit Fiend Garum & Black Bread
pit_fiend_garum.description: Roman garum fish-sauce fermented six months with pit-fiend scale and finished with thyme, served as a dip for hard black bread. Tiny dose, large effect.
pit_fiend_garum.sprite_desc: A small glass amphora of dark amber sauce stoppered with cork, a thick slice of black bread torn in half beside it

jormungandr_kaiseki.name: Jormungandr Kaiseki
jormungandr_kaiseki.description: Three small kaiseki dishes, each a single bite of world-serpent scale prepared differently: raw, seared, braised. The lacquered tray is a map of the sea.
jormungandr_kaiseki.sprite_desc: A long dark lacquer tray with three small white dishes in a line, each holding a single morsel of differently treated scale

sets_chaos_kabsa.name: Set's Chaos Kabsa
sets_chaos_kabsa.description: Saudi kabsa darkened with void salt and a single ground jackal fang in the spice mix. Served on a brass tray big enough for a war council.
sets_chaos_kabsa.sprite_desc: A wide brass tray of dark-brown spiced rice piled in a peak, a single fang resting on the top, three small bowls of yogurt around the edge

baba_yaga_zakuski.name: Baba Yaga's Zakuski Tray
baba_yaga_zakuski.description: Russian zakuski of pickled mushroom, celery, and mortar dust spread across small dishes. The crone insists you take one of each before drinking.
baba_yaga_zakuski.sprite_desc: A square wooden tray with five small ceramic bowls of pickled vegetables and a single shot glass in the center filled with clear liquid

pit_fiend_dolmas_grand.name: Pit Fiend Grand Dolmas
pit_fiend_dolmas_grand.description: Anatolian dolmas the size of fists, rolled with pit-fiend scale rice and demon-heart mince. The eater's silhouette warms the air for an hour.
pit_fiend_dolmas_grand.sprite_desc: Three large dark-green dolma the size of fists on a hammered copper plate, glistening with red oil, ember dust around the rim

jormungandr_pelmeni_grand.name: Jormungandr Pelmeni Grand
jormungandr_pelmeni_grand.description: Siberian pelmeni stuffed with both juvenile and elder world-serpent scale-mince. Boiled in seawater, served with sour cream and a single thyme sprig.
jormungandr_pelmeni_grand.sprite_desc: A wide white bowl of crescent dumplings in salted broth, a generous dollop of sour cream in the middle, a thyme sprig laid on top

sets_pit_grand_meze.name: Set & Pit Fiend Grand Mezze
sets_pit_grand_meze.description: Five-piece desert mezze: jackal fang shavings, pit fiend scale crisps, ember pickle, carrot relish, rosemary-flatbread. A war council's lunch.
sets_pit_grand_meze.sprite_desc: A round brass tray with five small dishes arranged like a pentagon, a stack of warm flatbreads in the center, each dish a different color

baba_yaga_grand_solyanka.name: Baba Yaga's Grand Solyanka
baba_yaga_grand_solyanka.description: Russian solyanka thick with mortar dust, a riddle stone steeped in the broth, pale celery and void salt. The crone says the broth is the question.
baba_yaga_grand_solyanka.sprite_desc: A heavy iron pot of dark sour stew with a single polished stone visible just below the surface, pale celery slices floating around

green_knight_pottage.name: Green Chapel Christmas Pottage
green_knight_pottage.description: Medieval English pottage thickened with green knight sap and finished with wild thyme. The cook chants the carving game's first line over the pot.
green_knight_pottage.sprite_desc: A wooden trencher of thick deep-green stew with herb sprigs across the surface, an iron knife resting against the bowl

charybdis_misua.name: Charybdis Whirl-Misua
charybdis_misua.description: Hokkien misua thread-noodle soup poured into a wide bowl while still spinning, so the broth catches the whirlpool's memory. Drink before it settles.
charybdis_misua.sprite_desc: A round dark bowl of fine white noodles in a clear broth still moving in a slow spiral, pale green celery shreds at the edge

green_knight_smorgasbord.name: Green Knight's Yuletide Smorgasbord
green_knight_smorgasbord.description: Swedish smorgasbord cured with green knight sap, the valerian-pickle as the keynote dish. Tradition: eat in three rounds, light to dark.
green_knight_smorgasbord.sprite_desc: A long pale wooden board with six small dishes of pickled, cured, and smoked items, each labeled with a tiny pine sprig

charybdis_kalan.name: Charybdis Kalan
charybdis_kalan.description: Keralan kalan curry built around abyssal brine and luminous spore in a yogurt-coconut base. Pale and almost glowing in the dark of the kitchen.
charybdis_kalan.sprite_desc: A copper bowl of pale yellow-green curry that emits a faint glow, white coconut shreds floating on top, banana leaf beneath

green_knight_anguria.name: Green Knight's Anguria al Forno
green_knight_anguria.description: Tuscan baked-cucumber dish with green knight sap glaze and cave mushroom stuffing. Said to keep the eye sharp through midnight watches.
green_knight_anguria.sprite_desc: A long pale-green vegetable halved and stuffed, dark mushroom filling visible, a glossy green glaze across the top, a sprig on the side

charybdis_paella.name: Charybdis Black Paella
charybdis_paella.description: Valencian paella inked black with charybdis brine and finished with void salt grains. The crust on the bottom is the prize; the broth above is the meditation.
charybdis_paella.sprite_desc: A wide flat pan of jet-black rice with golden crust at the edges, scatters of pale shellfish, a single lemon wedge on the rim

green_knight_carbonnade.name: Green Knight's Carbonnade Flamande
green_knight_carbonnade.description: Flemish carbonnade braised in dark beer with green knight sap stirred into the gravy at the last moment. The kind of dinner that ends a long argument.
green_knight_carbonnade.sprite_desc: A heavy enameled pot of dark-brown stew with celery chunks floating, a wooden spoon resting in the pot, a tankard of beer beside

charybdis_thali.name: Charybdis Coastal Thali
charybdis_thali.description: Konkan coastal thali plated around a central well of charybdis brine. The brine is the dipping; the rest is the conversation.
charybdis_thali.sprite_desc: A round banana leaf with seven small piles of colored food around a central dark-blue brine pool, a single lime wedge on the side

green_knight_hesperidum.name: Green Knight's Hesperidian Tart
green_knight_hesperidum.description: Late-medieval green-glazed tart with sap, clover, and thyme baked together under a lattice. They say the eater's wounds close on the walk home.
green_knight_hesperidum.sprite_desc: A round green tart with a golden lattice top, bright green filling visible in the gaps, a single four-leaf clover pressed onto the center

charybdis_kelp_kaeshi.name: Charybdis Kelp Kaeshi
charybdis_kelp_kaeshi.description: Japanese kaeshi sauce aged with kelp, charybdis brine, sea serpent oil, and valerian. A single drop on rice; the eater hears the sea thinking.
charybdis_kelp_kaeshi.sprite_desc: A tiny dark glass bottle of nearly-black sauce with a wooden stopper, a single drop on a white rice grain glistening beside it

green_charybdis_grand_pottage.name: Green Knight & Charybdis Grand Pottage
green_charybdis_grand_pottage.description: Half land, half sea: green knight sap stirred clockwise into the pot, charybdis brine stirred counterclockwise. The two never quite mix; both flavors arrive.
green_charybdis_grand_pottage.sprite_desc: A wide black iron pot of stew swirled in two visible colors, green on one side and deep blue on the other, herbs and mushrooms floating throughout

ravana_lankan_kottu.name: Ravana's Lankan Kottu
ravana_lankan_kottu.description: Sri Lankan kottu roti chopped on the iron griddle with ravana knuckle minced fine and rosemary smoke folded in at the last second. Ten-armed cooking, two-armed eating.
ravana_lankan_kottu.sprite_desc: A heavy black iron griddle with chopped roti and dark meat piled high, two cleavers resting on the surface, steam rising

wendigo_kasha.name: Wendigo Cannibal Kasha
wendigo_kasha.description: Slavic buckwheat kasha enriched with wendigo heart and rendered fat. The cook eats the first spoon to break the curse, then serves.
wendigo_kasha.sprite_desc: A small dark wooden bowl of dense buckwheat porridge with a single mushroom on top and a wisp of cold breath visible above

ravana_dolma_dasamukha.name: Dasamukha Dolma
ravana_dolma_dasamukha.description: Ten dolma rolls, one for each of the demon-king's heads, each spiced slightly differently. Eat in clockwise order to honor the king of Lanka.
ravana_dolma_dasamukha.sprite_desc: Ten small dark-green dolma arranged in a circle on a brass tray, each glazed with a slightly different red-orange oil, a small dish in the center

wendigo_kazocha.name: Wendigo Frost-Cure Kazocha
wendigo_kazocha.description: Cree-style cold-cured marrow plate, the wendigo heart slow-frozen and shaved into translucent sheets seasoned with void salt. Eaten with the fingers.
wendigo_kazocha.sprite_desc: A flat slate plate with translucent shaved sheets of dark red marrow laid in a fan, single black salt grains scattered across

ravana_curry_grand.name: Ravana's Grand Vatha Kuzhambu
ravana_curry_grand.description: Tamil dried-curry preparation with ravana knuckle pounded into the tamarind base, mandrake root for ballast. The pot is opened only once, and only when ready.
ravana_curry_grand.sprite_desc: A heavy black clay pot with a wooden lid pushed aside, dark brown-red curry visible inside, a wooden ladle resting across the rim

wendigo_sashimi_glace.name: Wendigo Sashimi Glace
wendigo_sashimi_glace.description: Hokkaido-style frozen-raw sashimi of wendigo heart with valerian shavings and a single drop of ice-water dressing. Numbing on the tongue, sharp in the mind.
wendigo_sashimi_glace.sprite_desc: A long white plate with four perfectly thin red-pink slices laid out in a row, white root shavings between each, frost still visible at the edges

ravana_thali_dasamukha.name: Dasamukha Ten-Dish Thali
ravana_thali_dasamukha.description: Ten small bowls of preparations from each of Ravana's heads on a brass thali. Eat them in any order; the king's heads never agreed on the right one.
ravana_thali_dasamukha.sprite_desc: A round brass thali with ten tiny bowls of differently colored foods arranged in a circle, rice in the center, a single naan folded at the rim

wendigo_smoked_zakuski.name: Wendigo Smoked Zakuski
wendigo_smoked_zakuski.description: Northern hunter's zakuski plate: smoked wendigo heart slices, void-salt pickle, cold mushrooms. The cook keeps the kitchen door open to the snow.
wendigo_smoked_zakuski.sprite_desc: A long pine board with thin dark smoked slices on one end, a small jar of pickle in the middle, dark mushrooms on the other end

ravana_ten_curry_grand.name: Ravana's Ten-Curry Banquet
ravana_ten_curry_grand.description: Ten Sri Lankan curries served at one sitting, each a head of the demon-king. The cook does not eat with you; the cook bows out at the door.
ravana_ten_curry_grand.sprite_desc: A long banana leaf with ten small heaps of differently colored curries running its length, a tall mound of rice at one end

wendigo_sky_burial.name: Wendigo Sky-Burial Carpaccio
wendigo_sky_burial.description: Tibetan-influenced raw carpaccio plated under open sky for an hour, then dressed with rosemary salt and valerian. The eater sees through their own breath.
wendigo_sky_burial.sprite_desc: A round slate plate with paper-thin red slices laid in a spiral, white herb dust dotted across, a single black salt grain at the center

ravana_wendigo_grand_yajna.name: Ravana-Wendigo Grand Yajna
ravana_wendigo_grand_yajna.description: A fire-altar dish prepared on hot stones: demon king's knuckle and cannibal spirit's heart cooked together with a single grain of void salt between them. Two appetites, one plate.
ravana_wendigo_grand_yajna.sprite_desc: A flat black stone slab still glowing red at the edges, two pieces of meat in the center separated by a tiny black crystal, smoke curling up

fenrir_jokulfeti.name: Fenrir's Jokulfeti Stew
fenrir_jokulfeti.description: Old Norse glacier stew built around Fenrir's fang and void-salt brine, simmered eighty days on a peat fire. The chains that hold the wolf taste of this dish.
fenrir_jokulfeti.sprite_desc: A heavy iron cauldron of pale grey stew with a single dark fang visible at the surface, ice-rime around the cauldron's rim

wild_hunt_smorgasbord.name: Wild Hunt Smorgasbord
wild_hunt_smorgasbord.description: Continental hunter's smorgasbord assembled while the horn is sounding outside. The valerian keeps the diners on the ground.
wild_hunt_smorgasbord.sprite_desc: A long table-board with seven small dishes of game and pickle, an antler horn laid across one end, a candle burned half down beside

anansi_jollof.name: Anansi's Storyteller Jollof
anansi_jollof.description: West African jollof rice with anansi story-thread woven through the grains. Every spoonful is a different tale; the eater finishes knowing more than they did.
anansi_jollof.sprite_desc: A wide brass pot of deep orange rice with delicate dark threads visible throughout, a wooden spoon resting in the middle

buer_plague_dosa.name: Buer Plague-Gland Masala Dosa
buer_plague_dosa.description: South Indian masala dosa with buer plague-gland mashed into the potato filling. The flavor is medicinal, the aftertaste is corrective.
buer_plague_dosa.sprite_desc: A long crisp golden dosa wrap on a banana leaf, a yellow potato filling visible at one end, small bowls of chutney beside

mammon_hunger_kalbi.name: Mammon's Hunger Kalbi
mammon_hunger_kalbi.description: Korean kalbi short rib glazed with a syrup made from ground hunger-crystal. The first bite makes you hungrier; the second satisfies; the third makes you contemplative.
mammon_hunger_kalbi.sprite_desc: Three glossy dark-glazed short ribs on a black stone plate, sesame seeds scattered, a small bowl of red dipping paste beside

amon_wrath_birria.name: Amon Wrath-Ember Birria
amon_wrath_birria.description: Jaliscan birria reddened with amon's wrath ember and tempered with rosemary smoke. The dipping consomme could power a forge.
amon_wrath_birria.sprite_desc: A clay bowl of nearly-luminous red stew, a folded tortilla on the rim, a small jar of dipping consomme glowing faintly beside

anansi_buer_grand_egusi.name: Anansi-Buer Grand Egusi
anansi_buer_grand_egusi.description: Nigerian egusi soup with story-thread woven into the seed paste and plague-gland for body. A long meal, eaten slowly, with strangers.
anansi_buer_grand_egusi.sprite_desc: A wide clay bowl of dense yellow-green soup with dark threads visible, a portion of pounded yam on the side dyed faintly orange

mammon_amon_paella_grande.name: Mammon-Amon Paella Grande
mammon_amon_paella_grande.description: Valencian paella charged on both axes: hunger crystal in the broth, wrath ember in the rice. Cooks itself faster than it should.
mammon_amon_paella_grande.sprite_desc: A wide flat black pan of dark-amber rice with the bottom visibly crackling, charred crust around the edges, a single lemon wedge on the rim

wild_hunt_sky_feast.name: Wild Hunt's Sky-Feast
wild_hunt_sky_feast.description: Continental-hunter four-element feast assembled while the riders pass overhead: horn, fang, root, salt. The plate trembles; the diner runs faster the rest of the night.
wild_hunt_sky_feast.sprite_desc: A long oak board with four small piles arranged in a line, a horn at one end and a fang at the other, the table itself slightly blurred

anansi_seven_seals.name: Anansi's Seven-Threads Feast
anansi_seven_seals.description: West African storytelling feast spun around four seal-demon essences bound by anansi's thread. Seven courses, one storyteller, no interruptions.
anansi_seven_seals.sprite_desc: A long banana leaf with seven small mounds of food in a row, each a different color, a single dark thread laid across all of them

nidhoggr_dolma_yggdrasil.name: Nidhoggr Yggdrasil Dolma
nidhoggr_dolma_yggdrasil.description: Vine-leaf dolma rolled around the gnawed root of the world-tree with wild thyme. Each leaf is folded with a knot the cook never explains.
nidhoggr_dolma_yggdrasil.sprite_desc: Three large dark-green dolma each tied with a single thread, glossy with dark sap, thyme sprigs scattered across the plate

samael_death_borscht.name: Samael's Death-Vial Borscht
samael_death_borscht.description: Russian borscht into which a single drop of samael's death-vial is stirred at the last moment. Black-red as a coronation cloak; warm as a final word.
samael_death_borscht.sprite_desc: A deep ceramic bowl of nearly-black borscht with a single white dollop of cream and pale celery chunks, a dark glass vial empty beside

beleth_quake_loaf.name: Beleth Quake-Stone Loaf
beleth_quake_loaf.description: Mesopotamian beer-bread loaf with quake stone ground into the flour and rosemary across the top. The crust cracks like fault lines as it cools.
beleth_quake_loaf.sprite_desc: A round dark-brown loaf scored with deep cracks running from the center outward, rosemary needles pressed into the surface

abyzou_silence_kaiseki.name: Abyzou Silence Kaiseki
abyzou_silence_kaiseki.description: Japanese kaiseki of two bites only, dusted with silence powder and valerian. Eaten without speaking; the cook leaves the room first.
abyzou_silence_kaiseki.sprite_desc: A small white square plate with two tiny morsels in opposite corners, fine grey dust scattered around them, a single closed hand fan beside

nidhoggr_taro_pone.name: Nidhoggr Taro Pone
nidhoggr_taro_pone.description: Polynesian-style pounded taro pone with root shard worked through and void salt dusting the surface. Heavy in the hand, light on the tongue.
nidhoggr_taro_pone.sprite_desc: A round mound of pale grey pounded taro wrapped in a green leaf, dark salt grains across the top, a wooden mallet resting beside

samael_quake_blini.name: Samael-Quake Blini Stack
samael_quake_blini.description: Russian blini stack layered with death-vial caviar and quake-stone dust between every pancake, valerian cream between every other. Eat from the top down.
samael_quake_blini.sprite_desc: A tall stack of grey-pale blini with dark beads and pale cream visible between each layer, a small dish of caviar to the side

abyzou_nidhoggr_kvass.name: Abyzou-Nidhoggr Silent Kvass
abyzou_nidhoggr_kvass.description: Slavic kvass fermented in absolute silence for forty days with silence dust and root shard. The bottle opens without a sound; the drinker remembers everything.
abyzou_nidhoggr_kvass.sprite_desc: A tall dark glass bottle of deep amber liquid with a cork stopper, a single rosemary sprig in the bottle, a clay cup beside

samael_void_tagine_grand.name: Samael's Void Grand Tagine
samael_void_tagine_grand.description: Moroccan four-element tagine sealed with bread dough for a day and a night, opened only when no one is breathing in the room. Said to keep the eater from dying once.
samael_void_tagine_grand.sprite_desc: A tall painted tagine with the lid being lifted just an inch by hooded gloved hands, the steam inside dark and slow

beleth_abyzou_grand_kabsa.name: Beleth-Abyzou Silent Earthquake Kabsa
beleth_abyzou_grand_kabsa.description: Saudi kabsa where quake-stone is ground into the spice mix and silence dust is sprinkled at service. The rice is the ground; the spice is the tremor; the silence is the spell.
beleth_abyzou_grand_kabsa.sprite_desc: A wide brass tray of dark spiced rice piled high, a fine grey dust visible on the peak, ground visibly trembling slightly beneath the tray

nidhoggr_seal_grand_yajna.name: Nidhoggr Seal Grand Yajna
nidhoggr_seal_grand_yajna.description: Five-element fire-altar dish prepared in absolute silence on a black slab. Root, death, quake, silence, salt. The cook never speaks of it after.
nidhoggr_seal_grand_yajna.sprite_desc: A flat black stone slab with five small piles arranged in a pentagram, a single thin curl of smoke rising from the center, no kitchen visible around
